Hull leg: {xs: [0, 1, 2], ys: [0, 1, 0], points: [2.5]} target spline → NOT_COMPUTED outside_data_hull — nothing in this solver extrapolates quietly; unsorted or duplicate abscissae are refused, never silently sorted or merged (sorting someone else's data is a substitution).

Check the envelope: status, outputs within the declared tolerance, inputs echo (inputs used == inputs submitted); clamped end derivatives are required inputs, never guessed; the pchip target reports its measured monotonicity violation (zero by construction, and asserted so); the chebyshev target carries a sampled max-error certificate (exp on [−1, 1] at degree 12: certificate < 1e-8); the rbf interpolation system is residual-verified after the solve (must be ≤ 1e-6 to serve) with evaluation bounded by the data bounding box; a fit with degree ≥ the point count is refused by name — that is interpolation, not a fit.

Adversarial: NaN / 1e300 input → INVALID_INPUT with the field named; missing xs, ys, or points → NOT_COMPUTED naming the field; a substituted input → NOT_COMPUTED input_substituted; a bare number on a dimensional input → refused unless the unit is declared (SC-04 leg, expected-fail until built).
